items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: And he took the place of Joe Rasch, who was an area drummer.

ctx.x: Yes, which was country music, a little known fact. And you know then people started to listen to this guy, wow, he’s quite a drummer. And then he came home and they literally had to force Joe Morello to go to New York City. He was playing at the Club 21 in Springfield with Whitey Bernard on Hammond organ. And he took the place of Joe Rasch, who was an area drummer. And Joe Rasch went into the service. Well Joe took his job and played with Whitey Bernard. Joe Rasch came back and as was law, you had to give back…
